overview_description.description: Datree is the creator of a git-centric DevOps management platform that allows for scaling without sacrificing visibility, information flow, or quality. The company's technology maps all code components, repositories, and committers while identifying their cross-connectivity to create a real-time, 360-degree catalog of the stack, allowing developers to optimize production with continuous delivery and a dependable flow of changes.

product.name: Kubernetes Misconfiguration Prevention
product.description: A tool that blocks the deployment of misconfigured Kubernetes resources, ensuring compliance with set policies.

product.name: Centralized Policy Management
product.description: A feature that allows management of policies across different clusters from a single location.

product.name: CLI Integration
product.description: A command-line interface tool that helps developers identify misconfigurations before deployment.

product.name: Management Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing insights into security posture, policy violations, and scan history.

product.name: CI Integration
product.description: Integration that enforces cluster policies within the continuous integration process.
